issues.description: About 5 years ago our street was repaved and since then we have experienced major flooding in our backyard and home during heavy rain events. We are on the downward part of a hill and the street wasn't properly pitched during repaving so every time we get heavy rain our neighbor's driveway (pictured) collects rainwater from the top of the street/hill and deposits it onto our property in a location that it is impossible for us to redirect. We have multiple French drains and sump pumps that can't keep up with the excess water. This is the second time in one year that we've had intense flooding along the entire uphill side of our house which finds its way into our finished basement and garage causing intense and expensive damage.
